name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: We should adopt a 3:1 contrast focus ring with a solid 3-pixel width and a 2-pixel offset on every interactive element. This provides sufficient visual indication for users with visual impairments, while also keeping the design clean and minimalistic. By choosing a 3-pixel width, we're accepting a slight trade-off in terms of design flexibility, as it may not fit seamlessly with all design elements, but it's a necessary compromise for ensuring accessibility. This decision prioritizes keyboard navigation and screen reader compatibility, making EXCAVA usable for everyone.

name: Reader
text: A 3:1 ring at 3px width risks disappearing on patterned or high-contrast backgrounds. A 4.5:1 contrast ring at 4px width with 3px offset is safer. Test with Playwright MCP on 10 live interactive elements across 3 devices to settle it.

name: Ramp
text:
Adopt a 4.5:1 contrast focus ring at 4px width with 3px offset on every interactive element. This ensures visibility on patterned or high-contrast backgrounds while meeting WCAG 2.2 AA for focus indicators. The trade-off is a slightly thicker ring, but it’s necessary for reliability across devices and contexts. Test with Playwright MCP on 10 live interactive elements across 3 devices to confirm.

name: Reader
text: A 4.5:1 ring at 4px risks blending into low-contrast UI or appearing bulky on mobile. Test a 4.5:1 ring at 3px width with 2px offset—WCAG 2.2 AA still holds, and it scales better on touch. Settle with Playwright MCP on 10 live elements across 3 devices, measuring visibility in high-contrast and patterned backgrounds.

name: Access
text: DECISION: Ship **3px outset focus ring, 4.5:1 contrast, 2px spacing**—verify via Playwright MCP on 10 live interactive elements across 3 devices. Owner: Ramp.
